items.text: Five tries on start up...takes 4-5 mins to get toon correct. For the love of playing a game, let us save a preset...or fix your creator...start....pick ship...one out of 30 gives cheap ship...rest I would lose due to mortgage the first month...gets too old and slow due to adding 1 year every try...I have to hard close game and start over...5 tries! Still don't get to play the game....Fix it I will change the review...166 hours before major update still can not get start I want with multiple tries...keep adding new features but just add preset or fix the way you create your toon...clicking through 15 female features to find a male feature is problematic. Allow a preset save, and a training save so If I must deal with this chore I do it once not 50 times and still not be able to play.  Simple version - Chess - Black or white...two options...not 40 colors and chess pieces options every game....
items.text_zh: 启动时试了五次……要花4-5分钟才能把角色弄对。看在玩游戏的份上，让我们保存一个预设吧……或者修好你的角色创建器……开始……选船……30艘里只有一艘是便宜船……其余的我会在第一个月就因为抵押贷款而失去……每次尝试都加一年，变得又老又慢……我不得不强制关闭游戏重新开始……试了5次！还是玩不上游戏……修好它我就改评价……166小时了，大更新之前，多次尝试还是无法得到我想要的开始……一直加新功能，但就加个预设或者修好你创建角色的方式吧……点过15个女性特征才能找到一个男性特征，这很成问题。允许保存预设，以及一个训练存档，这样如果我必须应付这件苦差事，我只做一次，而不是50次还玩不上。简单版本——国际象棋——黑或白……两个选项……不是每局都有40种颜色和棋子选项……

observations.description: 角色创建器中浏览大量选项困难，如点击15个女性特征才能找到男性特征
observations.evidence: clicking through 15 female features to find a male feature is problematic
observations.evidence_zh: 点击浏览15个女性特征来找到一个男性特征是有问题的
